content.comment_body: Hello everyone, sorry if this topic has been discussed before, I couldn't find a clear answer in previous posts. I have a transmitter that converts 3-wire PT100 signals into a 4-20mA current output. It operates with a DC supply between 10V and 30V. Will the [product_name] module handle the 4-20mA signal when supplied with 15V DC? Thanks, [user_name]

The [product_name] module supports 0-10V or 0/4-20mA as input signals. Its supply voltage requirement is 12/24 VDC, with an allowable range from 10.8 to 28.8 VDC. Therefore, using 15V DC should be suitable.

analysis.insight_summary: The inquiry centers on whether a 4-20mA transmitter can be properly connected to the [product_name] analog input module at 15V DC supply. The responses clarify the compatible input signals and acceptable DC voltage range for the module.
